title.narrative: EU-UNDP Partnership on Insider Mediation for Conflict Prevention and Peacebuilding

description.narrative: This project aims to strengthen the EU-UNDP partnership on inisder mediation. It aims to enhance and sustaine youth-and gender sensitive insider-medation capacities (incl. in selected priority countries), increase knowledge and capacities to implement effective support to inisder mediation and increase knowledge, experience sharing and networking opportunities, including through peer-to-peer support.
